title: Frontend Engineer Learning Roadmap
summary: A focused pathway that solidifies core web fundamentals, builds modern JavaScript and React expertise, creates showcase projects, and prepares you for job-ready performance. Each phase combines learning, hands‑on building, and reflection to accelerate real‑world readiness.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Reinforce core web markup, styling, and browser behavior.

milestones.title: HTML Semantics & Layout
milestones.outcome: You can structure pages with correct semantic tags and create responsive layouts using Flexbox and Grid.

tasks.title: Read HTML5 Semantic Guide
tasks.description: Study the MDN HTML5 guide focusing on sectioning elements and form markup.

tasks.title: Build a Multi‑Section Page
tasks.description: Create a static page with header, nav, main, article, aside, and footer using semantic tags.

tasks.title: Practice Flexbox Layouts
tasks.description: Implement three common UI patterns (navbar, card grid, footer) using Flexbox.

tasks.title: Reflect on Accessibility Tags
tasks.description: Write a short note on why each semantic element improves accessibility and SEO.

milestones.title: CSS Foundations & Responsiveness
milestones.outcome: You can style components consistently and make designs adapt to any screen size.

tasks.title: Study CSS Cascade & Specificity
tasks.description: Read the MDN article on cascade, inheritance, and specificity rules.

tasks.title: Build a Mobile‑First Layout
tasks.description: Create a simple landing page using mobile‑first media queries and CSS Grid.

tasks.title: Practice CSS Variables
tasks.description: Refactor the page to use custom properties for colors and spacing.

tasks.title: Connect with CSS Community
tasks.description: Join the freeCodeCamp CSS forum and share your layout for feedback.

milestones.title: Browser DevTools Mastery
milestones.outcome: You can debug HTML/CSS issues, inspect network activity, and profile performance.

tasks.title: Watch DevTools Overview Video
tasks.description: View the official Chrome DevTools tutorial on YouTube (search ‘Chrome DevTools Basics’).

tasks.title: Debug a Broken Layout
tasks.description: Use Elements panel to fix a deliberately broken CSS grid on a sample page.

tasks.title: Analyze Network Requests
tasks.description: Open the Network tab for a page and identify resource sizes and load order.

tasks.title: Reflect on Findings
tasks.description: Write a brief summary of three performance insights you discovered.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop deep JavaScript, TypeScript, and React capabilities.

milestones.title: Modern JavaScript
milestones.outcome: You can write clean ES6+ code, manipulate the DOM, and handle asynchronous operations.

tasks.title: Read ES6 Features Guide
tasks.description: Study the MDN ES6+ reference covering let/const, arrow functions, spread, and modules.

tasks.title: Build a To‑Do App (Vanilla)
tasks.description: Create a small to‑do list using DOM methods, event listeners, and localStorage.

tasks.title: Practice Async/Await
tasks.description: Fetch data from a public API (e.g., JSONPlaceholder) using async/await and display results.

tasks.title: Reflect on Code Style
tasks.description: List three ES6 patterns you will adopt in future projects.

milestones.title: TypeScript Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: You can add static typing to JavaScript projects, catching errors early.

tasks.title: Read TypeScript Handbook Intro
tasks.description: Go through the official TypeScript Handbook sections on basic types and interfaces.

tasks.title: Convert To‑Do App to TS
tasks.description: Add a tsconfig, rename files, and type‑annotate variables and functions in the previous app.

tasks.title: Practice Generics
tasks.description: Create a reusable typed utility function (e.g., a filter) using generics.

tasks.title: Connect with TS Community
tasks.description: Post your converted project on the TypeScript subreddit for feedback.

milestones.title: React & Component Architecture
milestones.outcome: You can build interactive UIs with functional components, hooks, and proper state management.

tasks.title: Watch React Official Tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the React docs tutorial to create a simple counter app.

tasks.title: Build a Weather Widget
tasks.description: Use create‑vite, fetch a weather API, and display data with useState and useEffect.

tasks.title: Practice Custom Hook
tasks.description: Extract the data‑fetching logic into a reusable custom hook.

tasks.title: Reflect on Component Design
tasks.description: Write a short note on how you decided component boundaries and props.

milestones.title: Accessibility Essentials
milestones.outcome: You can create UI components that are usable by all users, including screen‑reader and keyboard navigation.

tasks.title: Read WCAG 2.1 Overview
tasks.description: Study the W3C summary of WCAG 2.1 principles on the official site.

tasks.title: Audit React Component with Axe
tasks.description: Install axe‑core, run an accessibility audit on your Weather Widget, and note violations.

tasks.title: Build Keyboard‑Navigable Modal
tasks.description: Create a modal component that traps focus and can be closed with Esc.

tasks.title: Connect with a11y Slack
tasks.description: Join the #a11y channel on the Frontend Developers Slack and share your modal for review.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio‑grade projects that demonstrate the full stack of skills.

milestones.title: Responsive Portfolio Site
milestones.outcome: You have a personal site showcasing your bio, projects, and contact form.

tasks.title: Plan Site Structure
tasks.description: Sketch a sitemap and wireframes for Home, Projects, About, and Contact pages.

tasks.title: Build Layout with Grid
tasks.description: Implement the site using CSS Grid for the main layout and Flexbox for components.

tasks.title: Add Dark Mode Toggle
tasks.description: Use CSS custom properties and a React context to switch themes.

tasks.title: Deploy to GitHub Pages
tasks.description: Push the repo and enable GitHub Pages for public hosting.

tasks.title: Reflect on Portfolio Impact
tasks.description: Write a brief paragraph on how the site reflects your brand and skills.

milestones.title: API Dashboard Project
milestones.outcome: You can fetch, display, and filter data from a public API in an interactive dashboard.

tasks.title: Select Public API
tasks.description: Choose a free API (e.g., OpenWeather, GitHub) and read its documentation on the provider site.

tasks.title: Build Data Grid Component
tasks.description: Create a reusable table component with sorting and pagination using React and TypeScript.

tasks.title: Implement Error Handling
tasks.description: Add UI feedback for loading states, network errors, and empty results.

tasks.title: Write Project README
tasks.description: Document setup, features, and usage instructions in a clear README file.

tasks.title: Connect with Mentor
tasks.description: Share the repo with a senior developer for a code review via LinkedIn or email.

milestones.title: Component Library with Docs
milestones.outcome: You have a reusable UI component library and a documentation site.

tasks.title: Design Component API
tasks.description: Define props, default values, and TypeScript interfaces for a Button and Card component.

tasks.title: Build Library with Vite
tasks.description: Set up a Vite library project, implement components, and export them.

tasks.title: Create Storybook Docs
tasks.description: Add Storybook, write stories for each component, and document usage guidelines.

tasks.title: Practice Publishing to npm (dry run)
tasks.description: Run npm pack and review the generated package without publishing.

tasks.title: Reflect on Reusability
tasks.description: Note three improvements to make components more accessible and customizable.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish performance, interview skills, and job‑search readiness.

milestones.title: Web Performance Optimization
milestones.outcome: You can audit sites and apply techniques to improve load time and responsiveness.

tasks.title: Read Lighthouse Guide
tasks.description: Study the official Lighthouse documentation on performance metrics.

tasks.title: Audit Portfolio with Lighthouse
tasks.description: Run a Lighthouse report on your portfolio site and record scores.

tasks.title: Implement Code Splitting
tasks.description: Add dynamic imports to lazy‑load heavy components in your React apps.

tasks.title: Practice Image Optimization
tasks.description: Convert images to WebP, use srcset, and verify size reduction.

tasks.title: Reflect on Improvements
tasks.description: Write a short summary of performance gains and next steps.

milestones.title: Interview Prep & System Design
milestones.outcome: You can solve typical frontend interview problems and discuss architecture choices.

tasks.title: Solve 5 LeetCode Easy JS Problems
tasks.description: Pick easy JavaScript challenges on LeetCode and write solutions with comments.

tasks.title: Mock Whiteboard Component Design
tasks.description: Sketch a reusable modal system on paper or a digital board, explaining props and state flow.

tasks.title: Review Common React Questions
tasks.description: Read the Frontend Masters interview guide covering hooks, context, and performance.

tasks.title: Connect with Peer Interviewer
tasks.description: Pair‑program a mock interview with a fellow learner via Zoom.

tasks.title: Reflect on Feedback
tasks.description: Summarize strengths and areas to improve from the mock session.

milestones.title: Job Search & Personal Branding
milestones.outcome: You have a polished resume, LinkedIn profile, and outreach plan.

tasks.title: Update Resume with Metrics
tasks.description: Add quantified achievements (e.g., reduced load time by 30%).

tasks.title: Refresh LinkedIn Summary
tasks.description: Write a concise headline and summary highlighting key skills and projects.

tasks.title: Create Blog Post on Accessibility
tasks.description: Write a 800‑word article about implementing ARIA in React components and publish on Medium.

tasks.title: Connect with Recruiters
tasks.description: Send personalized messages to 5 frontend recruiter contacts on LinkedIn.

tasks.title: Reflect on Job Strategy
tasks.description: Outline a weekly plan for applications, networking, and skill upkeep.
